chunks: My shaykh, may Allah have mercy on him, informed me from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from his father, from al-Husayn ibn al-Hasan ibn Aban, from al-Husayn ibn Sa'id, from Hammad, from Hariz, from the one who informed him, from Abu Ja'far and Abu 'Abd Allah, peace be upon them, concerning:
A pregnant woman sees blood. He said: She leaves the salat (prayer), for sometimes blood remains in the womb and does not come out, and that is the bleeding.

key_terms.الْهِرَاقَةُ: the flowing or discharge of blood

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling if a pregnant woman sees blood according to this hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling regarding a pregnant woman who sees blood, stating that she should leave the salat (prayer). The reason given is that blood may remain in the womb and then emerge, constituting bleeding relevant to her ritual ruling.
